title: Magnesium: intestinal and nephron transport
sec: Magnesium: intestinal and nephron transport · p892
guide: Track ileal uptake and TAL-dominant renal handling. Distinguish passive claudin pathways from regulated DCT TRPM6 transport and connect each to inherited defects and drugs. Diagram abbreviations are taught as transport partners, not all as causal mutations.

title: Magnesium excess, drug effects and refractory deficits
sec: Magnesium excess, drug effects and refractory deficits · p893
guide: Compare drug-related malabsorption, tubular injury and transporter inhibition. Hypermagnesemia depresses reflexes and cardiorespiratory function; profound deficiency causes renal potassium wasting and impaired PTH action. The printed cardiac-arrest threshold is not clinically reliable.

title: Magnesium deficiency: causes, manifestations and treatment
sec: Magnesium deficiency: causes, manifestations and treatment · p894
guide: Link redistribution, pancreatitis, drugs and inherited transport defects to neuromuscular and cardiac excitability. Recognize low Mg/K as digitalis risk factors. The source prints an unsafe mg unit for IV MgSO4; do not memorize it as a treatment dose.
